This leaves $U_{\rm reg}=U_s+\frac12q\phi_s(d)$, because the point charge samples the finite cloud potential at its position.
sourceEdits.after: The regular cloud has charge $-q$, so the total charge enclosed by every sphere with $r>a$ is zero. I therefore use Gauss's law to conclude that the complete exterior field vanishes, without retaining the displaced point charge's dipole or quadrupole terms.
